$description: Ghazal design tokens, W3C DTCG style ($value/$type), ADR 0023. Single source of truth: edit here, run `pnpm tokens`. Dimensions are px (1 px = 1 dp), durations ms. Reasons live in $extensions.ghazal.reason and are never consumed by generators.

ref.$description: Raw ramps (docs/design/01-direction.md 2.1). Hex lives ONLY here; components never read ref tokens (ADR 0023 D7).

gold.$description: gold-500 = fills, hairlines, knots, never text. gold-700 = the only gold for text and icons. gold-650 (3.53:1 on canvas) = sole-carrier state strokes. gold-600 = decorative hairline only (2.77:1). gold-550 = pressed gold fill.

alpha.$description: Alpha is always an explicit token, never parent opacity (ADR 0023 D2). Name = ramp-step-aNN (alpha percent).

sys.$description: Semantic roles. Components use ONLY these (docs/design/01-direction.md 2.2).

ghazal.reason: disabled label on ink-100; disabled controls are exempt from 4.5:1 but a reason is always stated in words
7.45:1 on gold-500; the PRD ink-700 (4.12:1) is REJECTED for labels on gold
the only gold allowed for text and informative icons
gold text on ink-900 (8.75:1); gold-500 on dark is for lines and marks
best-in-row bead, held-day mark, ratings: informative gold glyphs on light surfaces
khayt, knot, selected-date fill, thread fill: never text
sole-carrier ring or bar (3.53:1 on canvas): now-knot ring, reply bar from 50%
strong decorative hairline (2.77:1): never the only carrier of a state
thread / range-bar track on light surfaces

scrim.$description: Single-purpose named scrims (direction 2.2). Photo scrims only; no other gradients exist.

illus.$description: Illustration roles (ADR 0034, docs/design/02-text-diet.md section 9): one Ink line, one Rose tint, one small Gold accent per drawing. Decorative: exempt from the text-contrast pairs.

ghazal.reason: secondary detail lines inside a drawing
the short ground line under a standing object
the quiet base shape of a drawing
a second, deeper rose area in a composition
THE one small gold accent of a drawing (8 px or less): a dot, a flame, a knot. Never interactive
a gold hairline accent (decorative stroke; gold-500 is the fill)
fill that hides what is behind an object; follows the surface the drawing sits on

space.$description: 4-pt scale: space.N x 4 = px (ADR 0023 D3), extended to 80 and 96 by direction 2.5. Aliases below name the structural gaps.

ghazal.reason: the only screen gutter (Majlis): 20, fixed from 360 to 430

spring.$description: Gesture release (ADR 0017): used identically by the motion library and Flutter SpringDescription. Never duration/bounce parameters.

the push distance signed for the other reading direction: CSS has no multiplication without calc (ADR 0014 --dir)
shake signed for the other swing: CSS has no multiplication without calc

font.$description: Three self-hosted families (owner choice, 2026-10-13, superseding the Newsreader/Amiri/Poppins/Cairo set of ADR 0030): El Messiri (display, both scripts), Manrope (English UI + figures), Almarai (Arabic UI). Static files, no runtime fetch, no italics.

ghazal.reason: Manrope has tabular figures (tnum) and its Western digits are used in both languages
em; stored per role in px as wordSpacing, this is the derivation constant

type.$description: Type roles per script. Composite value: sizes in px, lineHeight in px (explicit, never normal), letterSpacing and wordSpacing in px (ADR 0024 forbids em), numeric = font-variant-numeric. Line heights must be even integers (2/4-pt grid check).

ghazal.reason: eyebrow and field label; EN +0.14em uppercase (authored sentence case, uppercased by the shared label component), AR no tracking, no uppercase

direction 7: Newsreader 300 +0.02em, Amiri 400 x1.10; the thread and knot are drawn by the Wordmark component
figure inside a tab label (EN 12, AR 14)
